title: Role of arachidonic acid metabolism in intervertebral disc degeneration: identification of potential biomarkers and therapeutic targets via multi-omics analysis and artificial intelligence strategies.
summary: LASSO, random forest and SVM-RFE feature selection on intervertebral-disc RNA-seq data identified arachidonic-acid-related hub genes, with single-cell and bulk-data analyses supporting disease-stage associations; these are candidate biomarkers, not causal proof. The reviewed source supports this bounded result; external generalization, causal effects, and sustained operational impact remain unestablished where the source reports retrospective or internal evaluation.
